meta_description: Decspray is a professional painter and decorator in Leeds. Interior and exterior work, free quotes, fully insured. Call 07709 095234 today.
hero_subhead: From feature walls to complete home makeovers, we transform your space with precision and care.
services_subhead: We handle everything from small touch-ups to large commercial projects, using quality materials and proven techniques.

services.title: Interior Painting
services.desc: Walls, ceilings, and woodwork painted to a flawless finish. We prepare surfaces properly and use premium paints that last.

services.title: Exterior Painting & Protection
services.desc: Weatherproof your home with exterior paint that protects against Leeds' rain and wind. Includes gutters, fascias, and soffits.

services.title: Wallpaper Hanging & Removal
services.desc: Expert paper hanging for pattern-matched results, or quick, damage-free removal of old wallpaper before decoration.

services.title: Feature Walls & Accent Colours
services.desc: Create impact with bold colours or textured finishes. We help you choose schemes that transform your room.

services.title: Commercial Redecorating
services.desc: Office, retail, and hospitality spaces painted on schedule, with minimal disruption. We work around your business hours.

services.title: Prep & Repairs
services.desc: Proper surface preparation is everything. We fill cracks, sand rough patches, and repair damage before the first coat goes on.

about_pullquote: I started Decspray because I hated shoddy paintwork. Every job gets the time it deserves.
about_para_1: Decspray was founded over 15 years ago with one simple idea: that a fresh coat of paint should transform a room, not just cover it up. We've built our reputation across Leeds by showing up on time, doing the job properly, and leaving your home spotless. From terraced houses in Methley to period properties across the city, we've tackled every type of interior and exterior project.
about_para_2: Our customers come back because we listen to what they want, prepare surfaces the right way, and don't cut corners on finish quality. We're fully insured, tidy, and straightforward about pricing—no hidden charges or surprise invoices. Whether you need one room refreshing or a whole-house repaint, you'll get the same attention to detail.
reviews_heading: What Leeds Homeowners Say About Decspray

reviews.text: Had Decspray in to redecorate our lounge and hallway. Really professional, tidy workers and the finish is brilliant. They moved all our furniture carefully and protected everything. Wouldn't hesitate to recommend them.
reviews.author: David K.

reviews.text: Needed our kitchen walls and woodwork done before we sold. Got a free quote same week, no pressure to book. They came back three weeks later and got it all done in two days. Spotless finish and the buyer's surveyor had no complaints. Thanks Decspray.
reviews.author: Helen M.

reviews.text: Bit worried about having strangers in the house, but these lads were respectful and professional from start to finish. Did a difficult exterior paint job in awful weather and still got a great result. Will definitely use them again when we do the bedrooms.
reviews.author: Mark T.
